video_status: Original notes preserved; no enablement authorized; intro and reactions need timing / trigger verification.

texts.GTA_SUBS[3]: No fish were harmed. Several were inconvenienced.
texts.title: Escape from the Tank
texts.touch.rotate: Turn your device sideways for a wider view.
texts.keys[1]: In the tank: W back towards the hatch · S front · AD left/right
texts.keys[2]: In the sea: WS forward/back · AD turn · drag to steer
texts.keys[3]: Space up · C down · Shift sprint, hold: turbo → roadrunner
texts.keys[4]: Double-tap Space: barrel roll · double Shift: kick · I interact · V view · M sound · R checkpoint
texts.crimson.name: DocFish
texts.crimson.backstory: Four counts of grand theft aqua. Took a filter pump for a drive. When they pulled him in, he was still going round the scene of the crime. Bounty: 4,711 shells.
texts.angel.name: FlexiFish
texts.angel.backstory: Stole the castle. Returned the castle. The drawbridge remains at large. She maintains she bought a ruin. Bounty: 900 shells.
texts.mabi.name: Prof. MaBi
texts.mabi.backstory: MaBi has access to the filter, the lights and the feeding schedule. If you wake up hungry in the middle of the night, don't look at the clock. Look at MaBi. Bounty: 0xFFFF shells.
texts.mabi.staerke: Searchlights take longer to detect him.
texts.gold.name: Bullion
texts.gold.backstory: Bullion wears more gold than there is in the treasure chest. His defence is that it is his natural colouring. Bounty: 24,000 shells.
texts.neon.name: Strobe
texts.neon.backstory: Forty heists as lookout. Thirty-nine times the witness described a glowing fish. He maintains there must have been a lamp behind him. Bounty: 300 shells and a lampshade.
texts.clown.name: Prof. Humoral
texts.clown.backstory: Three pirates bought the same treasure chest. While they were arguing over who was taking it home, Humoral sold it to them again. Bounty: 650 shells and a red nose.
texts.puffer.name: Tetro
texts.puffer.backstory: Six inches in the original description. Twelve in the description given by the fish who had to pull him off a vending machine. Bounty: 2,000 shells.
texts.puffer.staerke: Takes one extra hit per level.
texts.guppy.name: Placebo
texts.guppy.backstory: Thirty thousand shells made it past customs in Placebo's company. The prosecution has yet to establish whether she was carrying the shells or the shells were following her. Bounty: 1,200 shells.
texts.sub.name: Endo
texts.sub.backstory: Filmed the warden's feeding schedule. Sold the footage to the warden. Endo doesn't say whether the warden was the first buyer. Bounty: 3,500 shells for the memory card.
texts.sub.staerke: Double sonar range, including chests and shells.
texts.leiter_bedienfeld[2]: By the hatch. At the back.
texts.leiter_code[2]: Four digits. Have a look around the tank.
texts.leiter_hinweis[2]: Have a look at the bottle.
texts.leiter_hinweis[3]: Cologne water. The number on the label.
texts.beam[1]: They noticed the empty tank. Stay out of the searchlights.
texts.combo[1]: Keep picking up shells. Don't break the chain.
texts.chest[1]: A gift. Don't ask where I got it.
texts.hook[1]: Bait on a line. Look past the food.
texts.truebe2[1]: Look at the water. The filter's off. Hurry.
texts.truebe3[1]: You're struggling to breathe. Get to the hatch.
texts.uboot[1]: Unregistered vessel. Nobody will miss it.
texts.augenGriff[1]: It's got you. I'll pull you out.
texts.codeRight[1]: Barrier down. Hold on to your fins.
texts.hooked[1]: I cut the line. You owe me.
texts.puffer[1]: A puffer. If it swells, move.
texts.wirbel[1]: Watch the current. It's pulling you in.
texts.wirbelRaus[1]: You're out. Find the next ring.
texts.level3[1]: More searchlights ahead. Trust the current.
texts.tunnel[1]: Keep moving. The tunnel won't stay dark.
texts.finale[1]: You made it. Take a minute. Look at the sea.
texts.time[1]: The guards change shifts in a minute. Move.
texts.canyon[1]: Low and slow. Stay below the searchlights.
texts.cells[1]: Red blood cells. They carry oxygen. Follow the flow.
texts.hintTank: The round hatch is at the back on the right.
texts.hintTankTouch: The round hatch is at the back on the right.
texts.hintOpen: The hatch is open. Swim through.
texts.hintPipe: Through the pipe, towards the light.
texts.hintSea: Follow the sonar to the next ring.
texts.hintSeaTouch: Follow the sonar to the next ring.
texts.lead: Tank Four. The filter is off, and there's a hatch at the back. Push it open, take the pipe and lose the searchlights out at sea.
texts.livesOut: Out of hearts – back to the start of the level
texts.levelGoal[1]: Find a way out of Tank Four
texts.levelGoal[2]: Follow the rings through the kelp
texts.levelGoal[4]: Don't stay in the eyes' gaze.
texts.doppelNote: Shells count double. One hit and the chain is gone.
texts.sheet.title: Character sheet
texts.sheet.perks.charme1[2]: Searchlights take longer to detect you
texts.sheet.perks.charme2[2]: Further delays detection and increases stamina
texts.sheet.perks.charme3[2]: Almost impossible for searchlights to detect you
texts.sheet.perks.power3[2]: Shockwave from your fist – coming with the action buttons
texts.SCHRITT[2]: Filling the tank. Now with 40% more water.
texts.SCHRITT[5]: Returning the fish to the scene …
texts.TIPS[1]: Tip: Interact with panels, objects and other fish.
texts.TIPS[2]: Tip: Sprint to get clear of the searchlights.
texts.TIPS[3]: Tip: Open treasure chests to collect shells.
texts.TIPS[4]: Tip: Stay out of the red light.
texts.TIPS[5]: Tip: Swim through the rings to save your progress.
texts.intro 10.4 s: They've been seen circling the castle.
texts.intro 15.8 s: They kept returning to the scene.
texts.intro 24.1 s: You've seen this in nature films.
texts.intro 25.7 s: Normally they'd cut to another animal.
texts.intro 30.9 s: please refrain from helping the suspects.
texts.flexa.knapp.01: We may need to slow the footage down.
texts.flexa.knapp.02: No, the fish that went past the light.
texts.flexa.knapp.03: The fish is still at large.
texts.flexa.knapp.04: Did you see it change direction?
texts.flexa.combo.01: If you've found shells in your child's aquarium, we'd like to hear from you.
texts.flexa.combo.02: Notice how the fish barely looks at the shells now.
texts.flexa.combo.03: We have a clear view of the shells. Less clear is where the fish is putting them.
texts.flexa.combo.04: The fish doesn't even slow down for the money any more.
texts.flexa.truhe.01: Who put a treasure chest in there?
texts.flexa.truhe.02: We are treating the contents as missing, presumed inside the fish.
texts.flexa.truhe.03: The fish has suddenly picked up speed.
texts.flexa.truhe.04: Could someone explain why the searchlight has lost the fish we can all see?
texts.flexa.licht.02: There. That's the fish we've been talking about.
texts.flexa.licht.03: We finally have a clear picture.
texts.flexa.licht.04: You can see the fish through the kelp.
texts.flexa.haken.01: Notice that the bait is attached to something outside the picture.
texts.flexa.haken.02: It has seen the food. Watch the line.
texts.flexa.haken.03: The suspect appears to have been apprehended by a fisherman.
texts.flexa.haken.04: You can see the line. You can't see who's holding it.
texts.flexa.mine.01: We won't be using that shot in the aquarium brochure.
texts.flexa.mine.02: The fish made contact with a mine.
texts.flexa.mine.03: Could we have a wider shot? I'm trying to locate the fish.
texts.flexa.augen.01: Look at the eyes. They don't appear to belong to anything.
texts.flexa.augen.02: I can identify the suspect. I cannot identify the witnesses.
texts.flexa.augen.03: The eye has got hold of the fish.
texts.flexa.hai.01: We have a shark in the picture.
texts.flexa.hai.02: At this point, nature films usually switch to the shark's point of view.
texts.flexa.hai.03: I hadn't intended to follow the fish quite that far.
texts.flexa.tod.03: Before we continue, that is the same fish.
texts.flexa.over.01: That concludes the footage of the escape.
texts.flexa.over.02: For those who missed the beginning, we have the whole thing on tape.
texts.flexa.over.03: We will return to Tank Four.
texts.flexa.level.01: The fish has reached the next section.
texts.flexa.level.02: If you've just joined us, this started in a very small aquarium.
texts.flexa.level.03: We've lost the view of the last section. Follow the fish.
texts.flexa.uboot.01: Who gave the fish a submarine?
texts.flexa.uboot.02: The vessel appears to have been built for a fish.
texts.flexa.uboot.03: It got out of one aquarium and climbed into a smaller one.
texts.flexa.kapern.02: For viewers at home, the previous description no longer applies.
texts.flexa.kapern.03: We are still looking for the same individual.
texts.flexa.leer.02: We'll keep the picture on the fish.
texts.flexa.leer.04: In a dentist's waiting room this would be considered calming.
texts.flexa.leer.07: I miss the days when you were just decoration.
texts.falkenstein.flucht.01: I put a castle in there. There isn't a castle on the bed of the Atlantic, as far as I'm aware. What does the animal want?
texts.falkenstein.flucht.02: A fish that gets out of its aquarium is generally a dead fish. Kindly stop congratulating this one.
texts.falkenstein.kelp.01: It's collecting shells. I should like to know what a fish regards as a pocket.
texts.falkenstein.kelp.02: I had made no allowance for a fish developing a private collection. What does it do with the shells when we're not looking?
texts.falkenstein.riff.01: The footage makes it look as though someone's laid out a slalom course. Those are sea mines.
texts.falkenstein.riff.02: We spend a great deal of time trying to establish what fish can see. I'd dearly like to know what this one considers an obstacle.
texts.falkenstein.augen.01: I wanted a view from each of the eyes. I now have an excellent view of the other eyes. Where is the fish?
texts.falkenstein.augen.02: It seems the fish has been looking at the eyes all this time. I had rather assumed it was the other way round.
texts.falkenstein.hai.01: At last, an animal that knows what fish are for. I wish you'd stop cheering for the little one.
texts.falkenstein.hai.02: That is a great white. In the cinema, the music would have told you about it several seconds ago.
texts.falkenstein.blut.01: Those are erythrocytes. I know what they are. What I would like to know is why I am looking at them from the inside. Is that my blood?
texts.falkenstein.blut.02: Those red discs are erythrocytes. For God's sake, don't start collecting them. I'm using them.
texts.falkenstein.frei.01: Could you at least turn the camera towards the fish? I'm getting a very comprehensive education in seaweed.
texts.falkenstein.frei.02: I used to be able to see this animal by walking up to the glass. I'm now asking a fish to turn round so I can see the coral.
texts.falkenstein.over.01: There. Tank Four. The little castle is still there. Let's see whether the fish has learned anything about the castle.
texts.falkenstein.over.02: Before we repeat the experiment, do you remember the way out? It matters rather a lot if it's the fish we're studying.
texts.falkenstein.ziel.01: There's no glass in front of it. I don't think I've ever seen that fish without looking through something.
texts.falkenstein.ziel.02: What exactly have we established? We put a fish in water and it went somewhere else.
texts.modeNote.gangster: More lights, higher speed, time limit.
texts.god.title: God mode
texts.credits: Credits: kelp, sea, light and fish schools after Adam Chernick, Codevember 2026 “Day 17: Kelp” (MIT). Caustic threads: Dave Hoskins (MIT). Sand, rocks, metal and wood: Poly Haven (CC0) – Rob Tuytel, Dimitrios Savva, Jenelle van Heerden, Kless Gyzen, Dario Barresi. Shark: "Great White Shark (Carcharodon carcharias)" by CanYuTsai, CC BY 4.0. God-mode duck: "Ducky" by Isa Lousberg (CC0). Tank after AquaCare (DocCheck Games). Props: Poly Haven, KayKit, Kenney (CC0). Cartoon fish, game and underwater sound: own work, no files.
texts.creditsShort: Kelp, sea and fish schools after Adam Chernick (MIT) · caustics Dave Hoskins (MIT) · sand and rocks Poly Haven (CC0)
